desc:
⚔️ Steal crates from dangerous dojos, defeat powerful bosses, and make it back home before another player knocks your loot loose!
Unbox weapons from tiny to GIANT sizes, place them on your pedestals to earn Cash, then train your Strength and unlock stronger dojos, auras, upgrades, and rarer loot.
🌙 Hunt for Secret Crates during Night
💪 Train, fight bosses, and grow stronger
💰 Build an income-producing weapon collection
🏆 Discover Mythic, Ocean, Shadow, and Secret weapons
